TextView.android:contentDescription: Expand provider privacy and fallback permissions

CheckBox.android:text: Use xKiro Free for Work coding (website + one-file edits)

TextView.android:text: OFF by default. When enabled with a valid key, selected Work goals and source may be sent to xKiro and its upstream model provider. Free-only model and remaining free token quota are checked before each request; unverifiable terms, quota errors and network failures stop without a paid fallback. No voice, attachments, unrelated files or saved LYRA memory. Automatic cross-provider sends require the separate Free fallback switch. Switching providers does not alter existing code until normal guarded Undo/Keep processing.

CheckBox.android:text: Automatically switch xKiro Work to available Free providers

TextView.android:text: OFF by default. One-time permission: on xKiro free preflight failure or final HTTP 429/502/503/504, send the SAME selected Work goal and approved source to OpenRouter Free, then Groq Free if OpenRouter definitively rejects. Groq requires its separate Free-account and inference-ZDR confirmation; LYRA cannot enforce a Groq account $0 cap. No per-request popup, voice, attachments, unrelated files, memory, paid fallback, timeout/partial-output resend. If all free routes fail, existing files remain unchanged.

CheckBox.android:text: Enable Groq Free for text chat (my account is Free and Inference APIs ZDR is ON)

TextView.android:text: OFF by default. Groq receives selected chat text and recent same-chat context, not automatically included project source, attachments or saved personal memory. Anything you paste into chat text is sent. LYRA cannot verify your account tier or impose a Groq $0 price ceiling. Turn OFF before upgrading Groq to a paid plan; Free quota can still run out. Cross-provider switching has its own separate OFF-by-default permission. Uninstalling LYRA may delete chats and encrypted keys—update over the existing app whenever possible.

CheckBox.android:text: Allow automatic Groq → OpenRouter Free text fallback

TextView.android:text: OFF by default. When BOTH saved keys exist and Groq Free/ZDR is enabled, Groq HTTP 429/502/503/504 may resend your complete selected-chat text and recent context to OpenRouter Free. This separately authorizes sharing that text with OpenRouter, including any code or personal details you pasted. No separately attached file/photo, automatic project-source injection, saved-memory lookup or voice content. OpenRouter is restricted to zero price, ZDR and no collection; no paid fallback. Unknown network failures, timeouts and incomplete replies never trigger a cross-provider resend.

CheckBox.android:text: Allow automatic OpenRouter unavailable → Groq Free WEBSITE fallback

TextView.android:text: OFF by default. Requires both keys, Groq Free/ZDR enabled, and your Groq account remaining Free. If a website build receives final OpenRouter HTTP 404/429/502/503/504, LYRA may send its selected website goal plus existing index.html, style.css and script.js source to Groq for ONE attempt. No other files, attachments, chats, saved memory, paid model or uncertain network retry. The source may be too large for Groq Free; a second 429 or incomplete reply stops without file changes. Groq has no API-side $0 billing cap; turn this OFF before upgrading your Groq account.
Z.AI DIRECT FREE API KEY (CODING ONLY)

CheckBox.android:text: Allow Z.ai Free for Work coding (website + one-file edits)

TextView.android:text: OFF by default. Z.ai is used only for explicit Work coding when this switch is ON. LYRA may send the current coding goal plus only the approved project source needed for that task: exactly index.html/style.css/script.js for a website build, or one selected file for a scoped edit. Z.ai is NOT used for normal Chat, attached photos, voice, saved LYRA memory or unrelated files. Missing credentials stop locally. No paid fallback, uncertain retry or silent switch to another company. Generated code still passes LYRA's local validation, stale-source checks, protected Undo and Preview flow before it is accepted.

CheckBox.android:text: Use saved LYRA memories in Workspace Chat

TextView.android:text: OFF by default. If enabled, up to four relevant, filtered saved preferences or project facts may be sent with your messages to OpenRouter Free only.
